checks: A Production count → Which ones reuses scope and freshly reads actual five-tool executor
Production status follow-ups refine the current population in legacy and persistent history without switching to My Work
Canonical status count/list equivalence and operation-preserving refinements share native filters
A bare lifecycle selector without a subject clarifies generically while definition and other-module context remain guidance
Archive inclusion is explicit, reversible and consistent across count/list; unsupported historical/material scopes clarify
Primary model-selected status enumeration uses the explicit On Deck selector, not the previous In Production filter or generated My Work prose
B named Job → labor retains canonical identity, requeries totals and never retains results
C original Bid remains a knowledge follow-up, never an invented relationship/tool
D Intake walkthrough and next-step context restore without provider invocation
E Inventory → incoming retains verified module context without enabling inventory reads/writes
F reopening on another handler preserves topic, identity and TTL without inference
G record and account revocation clear seeds or deny; legacy markers cannot resurrect them
H expired references, ambiguity, untrusted fields and arbitrary live payloads fail closed
retained collection context cannot bypass financial restrictions or persistence failures
Qwen source permission revoked during inference cannot publish or retain its answer
Terra orchestration receives only selectors after instance restoration, not prior live answers
